summary_claims.claim: § 3: Nasjonal kommunikasjonsmyndighet is the coordinating market surveillance authority and national contact point; § 4: Norsk akkreditering is the accreditation body. Literal: 'The Norwegian Communications Authority is coordinating market surveillance authority'.
The ministry proposes no penal provisions for breaches (19.2.4); administrative and coercive fines instead (§§ 5-6).
